scope: The historic Red Monastery church at Sohag in May 2024, including its tapered brick shell, two rows of arched recesses, roofless nave, eastern sanctuary and adjacent medieval keep.

originalReview.notes: Sunlit wide end and shaded side of the historic church show the two arched niche rows, tapered earth-toned brick walls, dressed corner stones and narrow cornice.

quallaSearch.notes: One exact Qualla file gives the useful 2024 historic church exterior and matches the photographer’s first-party CC0 release. The other story files depict a group and an icon and were excluded from the exterior model.
